title: Addition under polynomial encoding
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number and let $m,a,b$ be vectors of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Encoding the coordinatewise sum of $a$ and $b$ as a root of the monic polynomial determined by $m$ gives the sum of their individual encodings in the corresponding quotient algebra.
